defects.visible_symptom: Candidate truncation, duplicate identities at the cap, approximate ordering, same-band priority switches and nonzero movement could select or retain the wrong contextual target.
defects.probable_root_cause: Early producer-order capping and tolerant comparisons weakened the frozen deterministic order and movement-ownership contract.
defects.causal_production_change: Inspect every bounded input, reject ambiguous duplicates, use a strict total order, keep release-only retention separate, respect declared priority in hysteresis, and cancel on every finite nonzero movement input.
defects.verification_disposition: Verified closed by 84 isolated component checks, 36 static checks, 12 integrated checks and exact-artifact trace review.

defects.visible_symptom: A second selector or preview-side impact could duplicate outcomes, skip acquire dwell, or drive T06 contact motion while blocked.
defects.probable_root_cause: Legacy simulation/population selection surfaces were not yet delegated to the single T07 director and stopped dwell credit was not explicitly bounded at activation.
defects.causal_production_change: The simulation owns one director, choose_action is pure preview, step advances once and performs only actionable descriptors, population delegates selection, stopped activation credit is consumed once, and main sends only actionable descriptors to T06.
defects.verification_disposition: Verified closed by exact shipping-call-site tests, one-impact/event conservation, save restore reacquisition and independent sequence review.

defects.visible_symptom: Rejected run 34988772768 emitted transient texture-allocation errors, padded 55.57291666666666 percent of sequence rasters with navy, omitted the MP4 and measured screenshot waits as shipping CPU cost.
defects.probable_root_cause: The harness parented an unsized Control under the project's desktop stretch override and sampled elapsed time after render waits.
defects.causal_production_change: Fix capture-space size before parenting, neutralize desktop stretch for exact device rasters, reject uniform right/bottom padding, and end CPU timing before render waits.
defects.verification_disposition: Verified closed in run 34991148246: zero render-log errors, six full-frame 1280x720 sequence PNGs, 60-frame H.264 MP4, 19 unique PNGs and passing integrated C6 telemetry.
